research_question: RQ10: Calibrated epistemic uncertainty for selective prediction under coverage constraints
honest_findings: Baseline has zero uncertainty — score-only policy is the sole option.
MC-Dropout uncertainty AUROC=0.648 provides a real but modest discrimination signal (low unc → more likely TP).
Decoder Variance uncertainty is positively correlated with TP (AUROC=0.304 inverted); rejection direction must be inverted.
Joint policy performance relative to score-only depends on coverage level; gains are real but modest given AUROC=0.648.
Risk@Coverage is the most operationally direct metric; AURC captures uncertainty ranking quality.
mAP correlations with operational risk may be degenerate (identical mAP across some methods); CV reported instead.
